div.div:
web-ui Orchestrator Pod
Port 3000 (NodePort 30300) | Next.js 15 LTS• LangGraph StateGraph Supervisor: Planner -> Explorer -> Builder -> Critic -> Recorder
• Durable Checkpointing: FileCheckpointSaver (resume on crash)
• Tri-Mode Dispatcher: Auto | Flash | Pro (keep_alive: 24h)
• OTEL Tracer SDK: Turn -> Tool -> Exec waterfall spans
• Network Mesh: ai-mesh & egress-mesh routing

ClusterIP: 8080 | UID: 10001 (cap_drop: ALL) | read_only rootfs8 Autonomous Tools:
• workspace_get_tree, read_file, write_file
• workspace_grep (ReDoS complexity guard)
• workspace_run_command (Isolated Bash)
• git_status, git_checkout, git_commit (Argv-safe)
• execute_sandboxed_python & Attestation
NetworkPolicy: Zero Egress Deny-All (ai-mesh)
